meta.name: CCNL per i dipendenti degli studi e delle attività professionali (Confprofessioni)

notes.text: CONGLOBATED MINIMUMS: the minimo tabellare includes the contingenza (up to 01/05/1992) and the EDR (Interconfederal Agreement 31/07/1992), merged under CCNL 10/12/1992 and reaffirmed by Art. 138 CCNL 2024. The only fixed allowance is the ENAC of levels 1, 2 and 3S (Art. 141), gated by a role.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 170, daily divisor 26 (Art. 137 CCNL 2024: 'dividendo l'importo mensile per il divisore convenzionale 170'; Art. 45 for part-time).

TRANCHES: four tranches, 01/03/2024, 01/10/2024, 01/10/2025, 01/12/2026 (Art. 140 CCNL 16/02/2024, tables pp. 71-73 of the integrale; the April 2026 testo ufficiale reproduces them). The CCNL runs to 15/02/2027.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 14 (tredicesima Art. 142 + quattordicesima Art. 143 CCNL 2024).
SENIORITY INCREMENTS: triennial (36-month cadence), max 8 increments. Fixed amounts per Art. 134 CCNL 2024 in force from 01/10/2011: Q=30, 1=26, 2=23, 3S=22, 3=22, 4S=20, 4=20, 5=20.

ENAC (Art. 141 CCNL 2024): EUR 42.35 (level 1), EUR 102.53 (level 2), EUR 110.40 (level 3S) a month, only for the workers formerly under the Confedertecnica CCNL; the hires from 01/07/2004 get the minimi alone (p. 73). Modelled as an allowance with role 'confedertecnica_pre_2004' (compute(..., roles={'confedertecnica_pre_2004'})).

APPRENTICESHIP (Artt. 28-31 and Allegato B CCNL 2024, read in the April 2026 testo ufficiale, PDF pp. 143-144): professionalizzante 70% months 1-12, 85% months 13-24, 93% after, of the minimo of the destination level, one table for every profile; 30 months for Q, 1, 2 (track professionalizzante_30) and 36 months for 3S, 3, 4S, 4 (professionalizzante_36); level 5 excluded (Art. 30 B). Primo livello (qualifica_diploma, every level): 45%, 55%, 65%. Alta formazione e ricerca (alta_formazione_ricerca, Q, 1, 2, 3S): 40%, 50%, 60%. The last band of each track is open-ended: the apprenticeship is prolonged by absences over 30 days (Art. 28 I). A level covered by several tracks needs Apprentice.track.

SOLIDARITY FUND: the studi professionali pay the Fondo di solidarietà bilaterale per le attività professionali (D.I. 21 May 2024 art. 6) in place of the FIS and owe no CIGS (D.Lgs. 148/2015 art. 20 c. 3-bis): parameters.solidarity_fund replaces the FIS and CIGS shares of the terziario rates with the thirds of 0.50%, 0.80% and 1% by headcount. Up to 15 employees the rates coincide; above 15 the employer pays 0.46 points and the worker 0.24 points less than the terziario rates.
CNEL code H442: confirmed from the CNEL archive 'Studi Professionali — Confprofessioni'. Workers covered: 317,554 (UNIEMENS 2022).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: Art. 129 CCNL 2024 (p. 68) applies the scatti of Art. 134 to apprentices from the hiring date, and Art. 28 I counts the apprenticeship for seniority; the text does not say whether the amount is the one of the destination level. The engine pays no scatto during the apprenticeship (apprentice_amount is one series, not per level). Only an apprenticeship prolonged under Art. 28 I past 36 months of service reaches a scatto (EUR 20-30).

limitation.remediation: Let seniority_increments pay the level amount to apprentices (a flag such as apprentices_accrue_level_amount), then remove this note.

notes.text: LEAVE: 22 working days for the settimana corta (Monday to Friday), 26 for a six-day week (Art. 99 CCNL 2024, p. 51). The file carries the 22 days; the engine cannot switch on the weekly schedule.

limitation.remediation: Accept the weekly schedule (days per week) and accrue 26 days on a six-day week, or record the limitation as rol_not_accrued does for ROL.

notes.text: BILATERAL CONTRIBUTION: EBIPRO and CADIPROF are paid with a unified contribution of EUR 29 a month for 12 months, EUR 2 of it by the worker (Art. 13), modelled as the contractual funds cadiprof (20 EUR, health fund) and ebipro (7 + 2 EUR); an employer outside the bilateral system owes the worker 43 EUR for 14 months instead. The CADIPROF enrolment of EUR 24 (Art. 16) stays a caller BilateralFundEvent.

Art. 42: the lavoro supplementare of part-time at 40% of the quota oraria of the retribuzione di fatto, outside the deferred institutes and the TFR. OvertimeKind.SUPPLEMENTARY exists, but the file has no supplementary-hours band (review of 2026-10-30).

limitation.remediation: Add the OT_SUPPLEMENTARE band (40%) of Art. 42.

notes.text: Artt. 120-121: the comporto counted over the episodes of the 365 days before the last one, and the +90 days for serious illnesses paid 100% in months 7-8 and 70% in month 9.

limitation.remediation: Model the rolling comporto and the serious-illness extension.

notes.text: Art. 124: the 100% of festività during sickness.

limitation.remediation: Pay the festività during sickness at 100%.

notes.text: Art. 123: the infortunio integration (100% on the day of the event, 60% days 1-3, 75% after).
Art. 110 c. 8: the employer top-up to 100% of the holidays during compulsory maternity or paternity leave.
Artt. 91, 92, 97 C, 98: the ROL (40 or 66 hours) and the 32 hours of ex festività paid when not taken, the festività falling on Sunday and the flexibility hours not recovered.

limitation.remediation: Pay the unused ROL, ex festività and flexibility hours.

notes.text: Art. 56: the salario d'ingresso of the reimpiego, up to two levels below for 9 months and one for 6.

limitation.remediation: Model the entry pay of the reimpiego.

notes.text: Art. 58: the indennità di disponibilità of the lavoro intermittente, 30%.
Art. 115: the diaria of the trasferte, EUR 15 or 30 a day.
Art. 143: the exclusion of the quattordicesima for workers already paid extra months. The una tantum of EUR 400 (EUR 200 in May 2024 and May 2025, p. 73) is historic and outside the TFR base.

limitation.remediation: Add a worker fact for extra months already paid.

notes.text: HOURLY RATE AND SUPPLEMENTS (artt. 93-97, 135, 137 of the CCNL of 16 February 2024): without a caller value the engine derives the hourly base (the art. 135 normale retribuzione over 170) and the 30% on festività hours paid as straordinario festivo (art. 97 lett. E with art. 95); art. 97 also pays the hours themselves, which the engine does not post: the run is provisional. Not derived, the caller states the amount: ordinary night work, which art. 93 leaves to the Area Professionale or second-level bargaining (the 30% of art. 95 is a night overtime rate); work on the weekly rest day ('la relativa sola maggiorazione', art. 97 lett. F, names no percentage).

LEAVE, ROL (Art. 91 cc.2-3): 40 hours a year on a five-day week, 66 on a six-day week, and for the hires under the 2024 CCNL 50% from the twelfth month, 75% from the twenty-fourth to the thirty-sixth, 100% after; the text is silent on the first twelve months. The weekly schedule is not an input and the first year is not sourced: the ROL is not accrued, and a leave taken from it is not decided.

limitation.remediation: Add the weekly schedule as an employment fact and source the first twelve months of the new-hire ramp.

notes.text: LEAVE AT TERMINATION (Art. 101): the ferie are paid at the 'normale retribuzione di fatto' during the leave; no clause states the basis of the indemnity at the end of the employment, so the engine pays no residual (termination_residual_leave incomplete).

location.section: Art. 13 - Contribuzione alla bilateralità di settore
location.quote: A partire dalla mensilità di marzo 2024 il finanziamento di tutte le attività che vengono esercitate dagli enti bilaterali di settore (CADIPROF EBIPRO), come elencate dal presente Ccnl, viene effettuato mediante un contributo unificato mensile, per dodici mensilità, di 29 euro, di cui 2 euro a carico del lavoratore [...] Per i lavoratori assunti a tempo parziale i versamenti di cui sopra saranno comunque dovuti in misura intera. [...] 20 euro per 12 mensilità a CADIPROF. 9 euro di cui 2 euro a carico del lavoratore e 7 euro a carico del datore di lavoro, per 12 mensilità ad EBIPRO. In caso di mancata adesione al sistema della bilateralità e di omesso versamento del relativo contributo, il datore di lavoro è tenuto a corrispondere al lavoratore un importo pari ad euro 43 (quarantatre) corrisposto per 14 mensilità. [...] incide su tutti gli istituti retributivi di legge e contrattuali, compresi quelli indiretti o differiti, incluso il trattamento di fine rapporto. Per i lavoratori assunti con contratto di lavoro a tempo parziale il suddetto importo non è riproporzionabile.

provenance.transformation: CADIPROF 20 EUR a month of the employer, 12 months, in full for a part-time worker; health fund, so the employer owes the INPS solidarity contribution of 10% on it. An employer outside the bilateral system owes instead 43 EUR for 14 months, not reproportioned for part time, in the TFR base.
provenance.note: The 43 EUR element replaces the whole unified contribution (CADIPROF and EBIPRO): it is carried by CADIPROF only, so an employer that states neither fund owes it once; stating EBIPRO alone owes it too. The reimbursement of the benefits a non-adhering employer owes on top of the element and the enrolment fee of Art. 16 are not modelled.

location.section: Art. 13 - Contribuzione alla bilateralità di settore

[...] 20 euro per 12 mensilità a CADIPROF. 9 euro di cui 2 euro a carico del lavoratore e 7 euro a carico del datore di lavoro, per 12 mensilità ad EBIPRO.

provenance.transformation: EBIPRO 7 EUR of the employer and 2 EUR of the worker a month, 12 months, in full for a part-time worker. A bilateral body, not a health fund: no solidarity contribution and the worker share stays in the IRPEF base.
provenance.note: Paid with CADIPROF as one 29 EUR F24 line (causale ASSP). Its alternative is the element of CADIPROF.

location.quote: a) un contributo ordinario dello 0,50% di cui due terzi a carico del datore di lavoro e un terzo a carico del lavoratore, calcolato sulla retribuzione imponibile ai fini previdenziali, per i datori di lavoro che nel semestre precedente la data di presentazione della domanda abbiano occupato mediamente fino a cinque dipendenti; b) un contributo ordinario dello 0,80%, di cui due terzi a carico del datore di lavoro e un terzo a carico del lavoratore, [...] più di cinque dipendenti fino a quindici dipendenti; c) un contributo ordinario pari all'1% di cui due terzi a carico del datore di lavoro e un terzo a carico del lavoratore, calcolato sulla retribuzione imponibile ai fini previdenziali, per tutti i datori di lavoro che nel semestre precedente abbiano occupato mediamente più di quindici dipendenti

provenance.transformation: Thirds of 0.50%, 0.80% and 1%: 0.33333/0.16667, 0.53333/0.26667 and 0.66667/0.33333, in place of the FIS and CIGS shares of the terziario rates (the same thirds up to 15 employees; above 15 the FIS 0.80% and the CIGS 0.90%, 1.13333/0.56667). The studi owe no CIGS (D.Lgs. 148/2015 art. 20 c. 3-bis).
provenance.note: The 40% cut of the 0.50% for an employer without claims for 24 months (art. 6 c. 4; INPS circ. 5/2025 p. 3, https://ance.it/wp-content/uploads/allegati/INPS_Circolare-numero-5-del-20-01-2025.pdf, sha256 01d8fd32bc94bbcc676911786a222e50a89b73b4b1086641f559d0086a2b8237) equals the FIS cut of art. 29 c. 8-bis the terziario rates carry: EmployerProfile.fis_reduction states it for both. The fund covers every worker the sector rates apply to, apprentices included (INPS circ. 76/2022 par. 1). Only the ordinary contribution: the additional 4% on a benefit paid is not modelled.

location.quote: Per i primi 12 mesi 70% [...] Per i mesi successivi e fino 85% [...] Per i mesi successivi 93% [...] livello terzo (III)

provenance.transformation: Professionalizzante of III S, III, IV S and IV: 36 months (Tabella 2), same percentages as the 30-month profiles (Tabella 3). Level V is excluded (Art. 30 B, integrale p. 31). The 93% band is open-ended so that a prolongation of Art. 28 I keeps it.

location.section: Allegato B, Tabella 1 (printed p. 130); Art. 29 D (integrale p. 31)
location.quote: Per i primi 12 mesi 45% [...] Per i mesi successivi e 55% [...] Per i mesi successivi 65%

provenance.transformation: Apprendistato di primo livello: 45% for months 1-12, 55% for 13-24, 65% after, of the minimo of the destination level; Art. 29 restricts no level. The percentage covers both work and training at the school (Art. 29 D).

location.quote: Per i primi 12 mesi 40% [...] Per i mesi successivi e fino 50% [...] Per i mesi successivi 60%

provenance.transformation: Alta formazione e ricerca: 40% for months 1-12, 50% for 13-24, 60% after, of the minimo of the destination level; not admitted for levels III, IV, IV S and V (Art. 31, integrale p. 32: 'non è ammesso per le qualifiche del livello III, IV, IV/S e V'), so Q, I, II and III S.

location.quote: La quota oraria della retribuzione si ottiene dividendo l'importo mensile per il divisore convenzionale 170 (centosettanta).

hourly_base_provenance.transformation: Art. 135 (p. 69) normale retribuzione: the voci a)-d) (conglobated minimo with contingenza and EDR, scatti) and every other continuative element: base salary, seniority and fixed allowances (the ENAC of art. 141). Assegni ad personam and superminimi are individual elements the engine does not know.

source_document.title: CCNL per i dipendenti degli studi e delle attività professionali, 16 febbraio 2024, testo integrale definitivo (Confprofessioni)

location.quote: La normale retribuzione del lavoratore è costituita dalle voci sottoindicate alle lettere a), b), c) e d) [...] a. Paga base tabellare conglobata [...] b. Eventuali scatti di anzianità [...] c. Eventuali assegni 'ad personam'. d. Eventuali Superminimi.

provenance.transformation: Art. 95 pays the overtime hour 'con la quota oraria della normale retribuzione [...] e di eventuali super-minimi' and computes the maggiorazioni 'sulla quota oraria della normale retribuzione', which art. 135 makes of assegni ad personam and superminimi too: included in both.

provenance.transformation: 15% on the quota oraria of the normale retribuzione of Art. 135 (minimo, scatti, assegni ad personam, superminimi): hourly_base_method gross_incl_allowances.

location.section: Art. 99 - Misura del periodo di ferie
location.quote: è distribuito su 6 (sei) giorni. In caso di regime di “settimana corta”, dal lunedì al venerdì, il periodo di [...] ferie annuali è pari a 22 (ventidue) giorni lavorativi.

provenance.transformation: 22 working days, the measure of the settimana corta (Monday to Friday); a six-day week has 26 (same page), see the LEAVE note.

source_document.title: CCNL per i dipendenti degli studi e delle attività professionali, 16 febbraio 2024, testo integrale definitivo (Confprofessioni)

location.quote: In caso di licenziamento o di dimissioni, spetteranno al lavoratore tanti dodicesimi del periodo di ferie al quale ha diritto quanti sono i mesi di effettivo servizio prestato per l’anno di competenza, così come previsto dall’articolo 120.

provenance.note: Twelfths per month of effective service. The cross-reference to article 120 points to the comporto article and the month-fraction rule of the ferie is not stated: a partial month accrues nothing and the balance is marked inexact.

source_document.title: CCNL per i dipendenti degli studi e delle attività professionali, 16 febbraio 2024, testo integrale definitivo (Confprofessioni)

location.quote: In sostituzione delle quattro festività abolite i lavoratori matureranno 32 ore di permessi retribuiti ogni anno da fruire in periodi da concordare con il datore di lavoro.

provenance.note: 32 hours a year, apart from the ROL. The month rule of Art. 91 (whole months) is stated for the ROL, not for these hours: a partial month accrues nothing and the balance is marked inexact.

source_document.title: CCNL per i dipendenti degli studi e delle attività professionali, 16 febbraio 2024, testo integrale definitivo (Confprofessioni)

location.section: Art. 121 - Trattamento economico di malattia; Art. 120 (p. 65)
location.quote: 75% (settantacinque per cento) della retribuzione di fatto dal 4º al 20º giorno; [...] 100% (cento per cento) della retribuzione di fatto dal 21º giorno in poi.

provenance.transformation: Integration up to 100% of the gross retribuzione di fatto for days 1-3 (carenza), 75% for days 4-20 and 100% from day 21, stored as day_bands; comporto 180 days (Art. 120). Apprentices are covered (no exclusion). The comporto of Art. 120 sums the episodes of the 365 days before the last one: max_duration_days counts one episode, see the unmodelled note.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the file read again in the CCNL of 16 February 2024 (integrale definitivo, 78 pages) and in its April 2026 testo ufficiale for Allegato B, with the D.I. of 21 May 2024 and the INPS circulars for the solidarity fund.
findings: 60 records verified; the three document ids of the file are now one (ccnl-studi-professionali-2024-02-16), plus the 2026 testo ufficiale for Allegato B. The served integrale has sha256 89c22bb2..., not the hash recorded before.
Weekday overtime 15%, not 25%, and night overtime 30%, not 40% (Art. 95, p. 49), on the normale retribuzione of Art. 135 (hourly_base_method gross_incl_allowances).
Sickness: 75% for days 4-20 and 100% from day 21 (Art. 121), not a flat 75%.

Apprenticeship: Quadri are a destination of the professionalizzante (Allegato B Tabella 2, 30 months); split by duration (30 and 36 months); added the primo livello (45/55/65%) and alta formazione (40/50/60%) tracks. The limitation uniform_apprenticeship_percentages is closed: Tabella 3 is one table for every profile.
Added Fon.Te. (Art. 18: 1.55% employer, 0.55% worker minimum of the TFR base) and the payment day of the tredicesima (Art. 142).
INPS: the sector pays the Fondo di solidarietà per le attività professionali, not the FIS, and no CIGS: the terziario tier above 15 employees overcharges; declared as fsbap_rates_above_15.
Unmodelled clauses declared in one note (studi_unmodelled_elements); apprentice_seniority rewritten on Art. 129.
No renewal after 16 February 2024 found through October 2026 (the CCNL runs to 15 February 2027); the CNEL archive was not reachable.

reviews.scope: Readiness of the file after the limitations gained a headcount scope.
findings: The INPS gap above 15 employees (fsbap_rates_above_15) is now recorded on every run of an employer with more than 15 employees (applies_when headcount_from 16): up to 15 employees the terziario rates coincide with the solidarity fund of the studi professionali, so the file moves to production.

reviews.scope: Periodic review due 2026-12-01: the minimi tabellari of every level and tranche, the scatti, the ENAC, the divisor and the extra months against the CCNL of 16 February 2024, the solidarity fund against the D.I. of 21 May 2024, and a year and a termination of a 4th level worker against a hand oracle.
findings: The 32 minimi of Art. 140 (eight levels, tranches of March 2024, October 2024, October 2025 and December 2026, pp. 71-72) match the file.
Scatti of Art. 134 (p. 68): eight triennial increments, Quadri 30, I 26, II 23, III Super and III 22, IV Super, IV and V 20. Match.
ENAC of Art. 141 (p. 73): 42,35 at the I, 102,53 at the II and 110,40 at the III Super level. Match.

Tredicesima at Christmas (Art. 142) and quattordicesima by 30 June of the pay in force on that date (Art. 143), both in twelfths for a hire within the year. Match with the fourteen payments of the file.

Hand oracle (tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/period/sector, scenarios studi-year and studi-june): a 4th level impiegato hired on 1 January 2026 by an employer with 10 employees; every payment and the year (gross, contributions, tax, net, TFR, employer cost) match the engine to the cent.

fsbap_rates_above_15 stays open: up to 15 employees the terziario rates equal the 0.80% of the solidarity fund (D.I. 21 May 2024 art. 6 c. 1 lett. b), above 15 they need a contribution sector of their own, an engine change outside this review.
bilateral_contribution_or_element stays open: the per-worker amount of Art. 13 needs an employer fact for the alternative element; it remains an owed amount on every run.

reviews.scope: Hourly base of the time supplements and the supplements of ordinary night, holiday, Sunday, rest-day and shift work, read in the cited articles of the national text (text layer, or OCR of the scanned pages). AI review only: the same model extracted and checked the values.
findings: hourly_base_method gross_incl_allowances (was gross_incl_allowances), now verified: the engine reads it to derive the hourly rate of an event without one.
Supplement bands added: STUDI_FESTIVO.
Bands left out where the rate depends on facts the request does not carry or the text is unconfirmed; listed in the coverage note HOURLY RATE AND SUPPLEMENTS.

reviews.scope: Leave accrual: the ferie twelfths and month rule, the hours of each permit bucket (ROL, ex festività or the pooled PAR), the new-hire ramps and the basis of the indemnity for the residual leave at termination, read on the text cited by each rule. An AI review: the extractor is also the verifier.
findings: The values stated are those of the quoted clauses; what the texts leave open (month fractions, termination divisors, schedules and shift patterns) is not modelled and is recorded in the coverage notes.

reviews.scope: The bilateral contribution of Art. 13 (CADIPROF, EBIPRO and the element owed outside the bilateral system) against the CCNL of 16 February 2024, and the Fondo di solidarietà bilaterale per le attività professionali against the D.I. of 21 May 2024 art. 6 and INPS circ. 5/2025.
findings: Art. 13 (p. 8): from March 2024 a unified contribution of 29 EUR a month for 12 months, 2 EUR of the worker, in full for part time: 20 EUR to CADIPROF, 7 + 2 EUR to EBIPRO. Modelled as the contractual funds cadiprof (health fund, 10% INPS solidarity) and ebipro; the owed limitation bilateral_contribution_or_element removed.

Art. 13 (p. 8): an employer outside the bilateral system owes 43 EUR for 14 months, in every institute including the TFR, not reproportioned for part time. Modelled as the element of cadiprof, which ebipro shares (alternative_in).

D.I. 21 May 2024 art. 6 c. 1 (pp. 6-7): 0.50% up to 5, 0.80% from 6 to 15, 1% above 15 employees, two thirds employer, on the INPS taxable pay. Modelled as a solidarity fund whose tier replaces the FIS and CIGS shares of the terziario rates; up to 15 employees they coincide, above 15 the worker pays 9.52% and the employer 29.65%. The owed limitation fsbap_rates_above_15 removed.
Art. 6 c. 4 and INPS circ. 5/2025 p. 3: the 0.50% falls to 0.30% for an employer without claims for 24 months, the same cut the terziario rates carry for the FIS (EmployerProfile.fis_reduction).

reviews.scope: The renewal within the window of L. 199/2025 art. 1 c. 7 and the minimo in force before its first tranche.
findings: Renewal signed on 2024-02-16, first tranche from 2024-03-01: parameters.renewals.
Minimo before the renewal = the column 'Minimo tabellare in vigore al 29 febbraio 2024' of the first tranche (Q 2,133.31 to 5 1,315.12).

reviews.scope: The pricing of the seniority increments matured before a change of level (Art. 134 - Scatti di anzianità).
findings: Art. 134 - Scatti di anzianità (p. 69): the earlier increments take the amounts of the new level from the change: seniority_increments.on_promotion.

reviews.scope: Whether the individual elements of the worker (superminimi, aumenti di merito, assegni ad personam) enter the hourly base of overtime and supplements (Art. 135 - Normale retribuzione; Art. 95).
findings: Art. 135 - Normale retribuzione; Art. 95: individual elements included in the hourly base: work_rules.time_supplements.individual_elements.
